title: "Provenance"
subtitle: "What happened to a value before it reached you"
date: last-modified
---

The plain-language path from raw global model to the number a user pulls from the
platform. Every variable gets the same diagram with its own stages and its own
gaps, and only the variable-specific branches
and gap nodes change.

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
**How to read it.** Amber stages are where this pillar's **documentation
attaches**, the bias-correction steps and AE-side processing. Red nodes are
**known gaps/issues we disclose rather than fix**. An arrow not explicitly labeled is a
documentation hole to chase.
:::

## The shared backbone

Every variable follows the same five stages:

1. **Global climate model**: CMIP6, SSP3-7.0
2. **Bias correction**: differs by path. A priori on the GCM boundary conditions
   for WRF (*some runs only*), quantile-preserving and observation-trained for
   LOCA2
3. **Downscaling**: dynamical (WRF, 3 km, hourly) or statistical/hybrid (LOCA2,
   3 km)
4. **Cataloguing**: `cadcat`, analysis-ready
5. **AE-side processing** : derived variables, indices, localization

What changes per variable is **which variables each path publishes**, **what is
derived rather than native**, and **which gaps attach where**.

---

## Wind

```{mermaid}
%%{init: {'theme':'base','themeVariables':{'fontSize':'14px','lineColor':'#54687d','clusterBkg':'#eef2f6','clusterBorder':'#9aa7b4','titleColor':'#1a2733'}}}%%
flowchart TD
  GCM["Global climate model<br/>CMIP6 · SSP3-7.0"]

  subgraph WRFPATH["Dynamical path (WRF, WUS-D3)"]
    APBC["A priori bias correction of GCM<br/>boundary conditions (some models only)"]
    WRFDS["WRF dynamical downscaling<br/>3 km CA · hourly"]
    WRFOUT["Native 10 m wind: uas, vas"]
    APBC --> WRFDS --> WRFOUT
  end

  subgraph LOCAPATH["Statistical / hybrid path (LOCA2)"]
    LOCABC["Quantile-preserving bias correction<br/>obs-trained"]
    LOCADS["LOCA2 hybrid downscaling<br/>3 km"]
    LOCAOUT["uas, vas, wspeed"]
    LOCABC --> LOCADS --> LOCAOUT
  end

  GCM --> APBC
  GCM --> LOCABC
  %% WRFDS -. "3 km WRF pattern library" .-> LOCADS

  CAT["cadcat catalog<br/>analysis-ready"]
  WRFOUT --> CAT
  LOCAOUT --> CAT

  %% AE["AE-side processing<br/>derived speed &amp; direction · FFWI · localization"]
  AE["AE-side processing<br/>derived speed &amp; direction"]
  CAT --> AE
  USER["AE users<br/>climakitae · AE platform"]
  AE --> USER

  %% BCGAP["GAP: which runs bias-corrected vs not?<br/>AE serves the non-a-priori-BC WRF (Q02)"]
  %% APBC -.-> BCGAP
  %% PARITY["GAP: wind not downscaled<br/>at parity in LOCA2 (R02)"]
  %% LOCADS -.-> PARITY
  DQ4["NOTE: wspeed not equal to<br/>sqrt(uas^2 + vas^2) — DQ4. Wind speed downscaeled on its own, use that."]
  LOCAOUT -.-> DQ4

  classDef pipeline fill:#d8e6f5,stroke:#3b6ea5,color:#0f2540,stroke-width:1px;
  classDef doc fill:#fbe2c4,stroke:#b7791f,color:#3a2d00,stroke-width:1px;
  classDef gap fill:#f6d6d4,stroke:#b23b34,color:#4a1512,stroke-width:1px;

  class GCM,WRFDS,WRFOUT,LOCADS,LOCAOUT,CAT,USER pipeline;
  class APBC,LOCABC,AE doc;
  class BCGAP,PARITY,DQ4 gap;

  style WRFPATH fill:#eef2f6,stroke:#9aa7b4,color:#1a2733;
  style LOCAPATH fill:#eef2f6,stroke:#9aa7b4,color:#1a2733;
```


### What the wind diagram exposes


- **The bias-correction ambiguity (amber → red).** The WRF a priori bias correction exists
  for some runs and not others, and AE appears to serve the *non*-a-priori-BC WRF *([R19](../references.qmd#R19) run
  matrix; [Q02](../references.qmd#Q02) App. A)*. Resolving which cadcat runs are which is the first bias-adjustment
  documentation task — and if the answer is inconsistent across simulations, that is itself a
  data-quality finding.
- **LOCA2 wind parity ([R02](../references.qmd#R02)).** The hybrid path produces a wind field, but wind is not
  statistically downscaled the way temperature and precipitation are. This becomes the
  "use-with-caution" basis for every LOCA2 wind row in the [matrix](../guidance/good-bad-matrix.qmd).
- **The `wspeed` discrepancy ([DQ4](../references.qmd#DQ4)).** `wspeed` does not reconcile with the components in the
  LOCA2 hybrid files. Wind speed is downscaled independently 
  rather than derived from the components. `wspeed`
  [variable card](../guidance/variable-cards.qmd).
